question_sw: Tofauti kati ya P9 na P10 ni nini kwa madhumuni ya PAYE?
answer_sw: P10 ni fomu ya KILA MWEZI ya kuwasilisha na kulipa PAYE iliyokatwa kwa kipindi. P9 ni TAARIFA YA MWAKA ya PAYE — inawasilishwa mara moja kwa mwaka ifikapo tarehe 31 Machi na inatoa muhtasari wa PAYE yote iliyolipwa na mwaka. Waajiri wanahitaji zote mbili — P10 kila mwezi na P9 mwishoni mwa mwaka.
question_en: What is the difference between P9 and P10 for PAYE purposes?
answer_en: P10 is the MONTHLY form for submitting and paying PAYE deducted for the period. P9 is the ANNUAL PAYE RETURN — filed once per year by 31 March summarising all PAYE paid through the year. Employers need both — P10 monthly and P9 at year end.

question_sw: P9 form kwa mfanyakazi mgeni — ni nini na inapaswa kutolewa lini?
answer_sw: P9 form ni hati ya muhtasari ya kila mwaka wa kodi inayoonyesha: jumla ya mapato ya mfanyakazi, jumla ya PAYE iliyokatwa, na personal relief iliyotumika. Inahitajika kutolewa na mwajiri kwa kila mfanyakazi — raia na wageni — kabla ya 31 Machi ya mwaka unaofuata wa kodi.
question_en: P9 form for a foreign employee — what is it and when must it be issued?
answer_en: The P9 form is an annual tax year summary document showing: total employee income, total PAYE deducted, and personal relief applied. It must be issued by the employer to every employee — citizens and foreigners — before 31 March of the following tax year.
